name: @lyku/para-extract
description: Checker-driven TS → Para schema extractor (para-ts-extractor-plan.md). Resolves TypeScript types through the compiler API and lowers them to plain JSON Schema bodies for the Para schema registry: recursion becomes module-relative { $ref: "#Name" } registry references, exactly like Para-native recursion. TS-derived schemas are pure structure: capability modifiers (cyclic/depth/identity) live on the wrapping Para declaration, never inferred from TS source. NOT YET RELEASED: private:true / 0.0.0-dev pending the workspace split.
